title: Software Modeling Team Leader
teaser: Exciting opportunity for a Software Modeling Team Leader to drive the development of a unified silicon architecture for Cisco SiliconOne devices. Lead a team delivering a state-of-the-art functional simulator, collaborating with cross-functional experts. Ideal for experienced leaders in software or ASIC development with strong programming and mentoring skills.
description:
Meet the Team 

Join the Cisco Silicon One team in developing a unified silicon architecture for web-scale, service provider, and enterprise networks. Cisco's silicon team provides an outstanding, unique experience for Software and ASIC engineers by combining the resources offered by a sizable multi-geography silicon organization and a large campus with the startup culture and breadth of growth opportunities that working in a smaller ASIC team can provide. 

Your Impact 

As the leader of the team, you will be responsible for delivering a state-of-the-art functional simulator for the Cisco SiliconOne family of routing and switching devices. This simulator is a critical product that streamlines the development process and significantly reduces time-to-market. 

In this role, you will: 

Lead and mentor and scale the team to 7-10 engineers, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment

Oversee the design and delivery of a high-performance, reliable, and user-friendly behavioral model for Cisco SiliconOne devices

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including ASIC Architecture, Software, and Hardware to align goals and ensure seamless execution

Champion engineering excellence by modeling hands-on problem solving and debugging best practices

Guide team members in their professional development with tailored growth plans and regular feedback

Minimum Qualifications: 

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related degree, and 8+ years of related experience, or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related degree, and 5+ years of related experience

5 Years or more of hands-on Software and/or ASIC development

3 Years of proven leadership in a team/domain of at least 5 engineers in a software and/or ASIC development

Demonstrated programming experience with C or C++, or System Verilog or Design Verification

Consistently achieved positive collaboration and effective communication skills
 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Prior experience designing and implementing ASIC functional simulators

Prior experience in Data Networks

Possess both Software development and ASIC development experience
